summary: Eleven-phase implementation plan written for the frame-class Galois-closure layer, in three dependency waves (wave 1: phases 1,3,4,7,9; wave 2: 2,10; wave 3: 5,6,8,11). The research report's nine-phase decomposition was adopted with three structural changes. (a) Phase 3 GENERALIZES the existing Theorems/DiscreteUnfolding.lean:90 succIndicator in place rather than adding the report's proposed new nextTopThm -- the existing declaration is already the same serial_future + prior_UZ + guardMono derivation of X-top, so the report's phase would have duplicated it; the plan specifies redefining succIndicator as the le_rfl instantiation of a new guarded succIndicatorAt so the two in-file call sites are untouched. (b) No new nextTop is defined: Formula.next Formula.top is the Syntax-level spelling and two Metalogic-local copies already exist; the plan forbids a third and fences the pre-existing duplication out of scope. (c) The report's phase 7 (~350 lines) and phase 9 (~450 lines) each exceeded one agent run, so they are split into 7/8 and 10/11 respectively. All three dispatch corrections are carried into every phase (Dedekind not Complete; IsDiscrete not Sat .Discrete for the paper-Discrete corollary; pre-512 FrameOver/worldNonempty rename pass), the AxiomSet design decision is recorded as closed with a hard stop-and-report-a-blocker contract if any phase reaches for a single-frame swapTemporal closure lemma, and deliverable (6)'s non-goals are preserved verbatim. The Walk/MinCyc apparatus is scoped as optional phases 10-11 so phases 1-9 land the rest of the task without it. Validator passes --strict with 0 warnings.
